ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The file on Lebanon is kept in drawer 8. ... The file on Italy is kept in drawer 1. ... The file on Russia is kept in drawer 6. ... Which drawer holds the file on the country whose capital is Rome?" -> answer org 1; the alt prompt asks about the Lebanon (bridge alt), its 5th statement. Possible answers after the patch: 8 (answer of bridge alt's statement), 6 (answer at the same statement slot), 4 (the alt prompt's own answer), 1 (answer org kept).
